name: execution-plan
description: Drive the end-to-end execution of any coherent piece of code work in a GitHub-hosted project: size-scaled design pass, issue, Kanban, branch, implement, internal code and security review loops, validation gates, atomic commits, live verification, PR, automated-reviewer loop, review-thread triage, merge per project policy, optional release, and persisting what was learned. Project-specific values come from the project's own workflow doc.
